column1: # SECTION 2: TEST OBSERVATION DATA FOR ALL 17 OIML R 76-1 METROLOGICAL TESTS
# 1. test_code   : Statutory test code identifier (T1 to T15 / OIML clauses)
# 2. point_name  : Unique step or measurement description
# 3. load_L      : Reference applied standard test mass (in instrument unit
# 4. indication_I: Observed reading on scale indicator (I)
# 5. delta_L     : Additional fractional mass applied to observe changeover (ΔL ≈ 0.5d)
# TEST 1: ZERO-SETTING AND ZERO-TRACKING ACCURACY (OIML R 76-1: A.4.1
# Formula: E0 = I0 + 0.5d - ΔL0 - L0; Limit: |E0| <= 0.25e
# TEST 2: WEIGHING PERFORMANCE / LINEARITY (OIML R 76-1: A.4.4
# 5 test load levels across range: Min
# Formula: P = I + 0.5d - ΔL; E = P - L; Ec = E - E0; Limit: |Ec| <= MPE
# 10 consecutive load applications at 1/2 Max (7500g) and Max (15000g)
# Formula: ΔP_max = Max(P) - Min(P); Limit: ΔP_max <= 1.0 * |MPE(L)|
# TEST 4: ECCENTRICITY / OFF-CENTRE LOADING (OIML R 76-1: A.4.7)
# Applied Load: 1/3 Max (5000g) at 4 quadrants and Centre
# Formula: Ec = E - E0; Limit: |Ec| <= MPE(1/3 Max)
# TEST 5: TARE DEVICE & TARE WEIGHING ACCURACY (OIML R 76-1: A.4.6)
# Verification of Tare setting precision (<=0.25e) and net indication linearity
# An extra load ΔL = 1.4d smoothly placed shall provoke clear indication increase
# Minimum displacement of indicating pointer for non-self indicating apparatus
# Inclined to 1/1000 and 50/1000; zero and load indication deviation checked
# TEST 9: TEMPERATURE EFFECT ON NO-LOAD INDICATION (OIML R 76-1: A.5.3.2)
# Conditioned at 20°C reference and 40°C with 85% RH for 48 hours
# TEST 11: VOLTAGE VARIATIONS TEST (OIML R 76-1: A.5.4)
# Supply voltage varied to 0.85 Unom (195.5 V) and 1.10 Unom (253.0 V)
# TEST 12: SHORT TIME POWER REDUCTIONS / AC MAINS DIPS (OIML R 76-1: B.3.1)
# TEST 13: ELECTRICAL FAST TRANSIENTS / BURSTS (OIML R 76-1: B.3.2)
# TEST 14: ELECTROSTATIC DISCHARGE - ESD (OIML R 76-1: B.3.4)
# Contact discharge: ±6 kV; Air discharge: ±8 kV
# TEST 15: IMMUNITY TO RADIATED ELECTROMAGNETIC RF FIELDS (OIML R 76-1: B.3.5)
# TEST 16: SPAN STABILITY TEST (OIML R 76-1: B.4)
